entities.name: Loch Prith
entities.description: Underground lake settlement on Cridhe reached through a secret entrance in the Westlands, refuge for lumini, elves and refugees of Inys Nohr.

entities.name: Gwylfan
entities.description: The three original inhabitants Antistita, Vestira and Praetis, who weave Cridhe's history and prophecies.

entities.name: Maker
entities.description: Said to have placed the Gwylfan at Loch Prith.

entities.name: Thrissa
entities.description: Prophetess who returned to Loch Prith after giving birth to Nazir.

entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: Thrissa's husband who brought Aylith to Loch Prith.

entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Girl healed and guided at Loch Prith, who faces trials.

entities.name: Raphos
entities.description: Blacksmith frozen at the time of his impending death, healed of hatred by Aylith's touch.

entities.name: Mirkalbions
entities.description: People offered Loch Prith as a home by Feryar.

events.summary: Thrissa returns to Loch Prith after giving birth to Nazir.
events.quote: Thrissa returned to Loch Prith after giving birth to Nazir

events.summary: Feryar arrives with Aylith, who is healed of her mortal wounds by elven herbs and magic.
events.quote: she was healed of her mortal wounds by the elven herbs and magic.

events.summary: The Gwylfan tell Aylith more of her destiny.
events.quote: Then Aylith met with the Gwylfan, who told her more of her destiny

events.summary: Aylith faces Raphos, who almost kills her but is healed of his hatred by her touch and disintegrates.
events.quote: when he touched her flesh, he was healed of his hatred, and disintegrated.

events.summary: After the Mending of the Clan Tree, Feryar offers Loch Prith as a home to the Mirkalbions.
events.quote: Feryar offered Loch Prith as a home to the Mirkalbions

relations.quote: her husband Feryar arrived with Aylith of Inys Haen
Loch Prith is an underground lake on Cridhe
